description: Free mailbox short codes for guided outgoing test calls. The user dials, unless --auto-call mailbox: then the lab calls the inserted SIM's own entry here and no other number (lab_calls.check_auto_call also refuses emergency, 0-prefixed and 11x/19x service numbers even if they were listed here). Source: S20_Project/research_notes/IMS retry backoff and test calls/test_calls.md (2026-10-18), Key Question 2. A code marked unverified rests on one secondary source. Each entry's free (rule round 31, SM9) says whether the allowlist marks the mailbox call (calls) and an SMS to the SIM's own number (sms) free for that carrier; builds other ROMs ship call and send only where it is true, and never while roaming. calls is true where the sources agree that calling the own mailbox from a German SIM at home costs nothing (teltarif, GIGA, the operator's help pages; test_calls.md Key Question 2). It is false for a code marked unverified and for 1&1, whose code differs on Vodafone national roaming, where the listed one may reach another service. sms is false everywhere: no source states that an SMS to one's own number is free on every tariff, and prepaid tariffs bill it.
